added_failure_derivation: logs/baseline_suite.log runs at eda6cfd6e in an empty scratch tree and exits 4 with 'file or directory not found', collecting no tests, so its failure_ids are empty and completed is false; logs/after_suite.log at 5212f19e1 records '9 passed', EXIT=0; added_failure_ids is the head arm's failing ids minus the base arm's, hence [] and added_failure_count 0.

findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion compares np.corrcoef of a series with np.corrcoef of the same series divided by one constant, an exact scale invariance of Pearson correlation, so no change to study.py or lag_table.py can redden it and it guards nothing.

non-blocking: GENERATING_AXIS copies the axis study.py:308 writes to study/generating.json and analyse.py:159 reads from there, so a rebuilt study is checked against a stale constant and a failing RMSE names the wrong truth.
non-blocking: the jsonl is opened inline and never closed, leaking a descriptor per sequence and producing the two ResourceWarnings recorded in logs/after_suite.log.

non-blocking: the guard skips whenever ~/.config/reckon/crew/runs lacks the arms, which is the state under a reckon worker whose HOME is the run's omp-home, so it reports green without checking in the environment that runs gates.
